title: Turkey Bois
summary: A cooperative arena shooter built around shotgun-powered flight, procedural maps, proximity chat, and feeding a very hungry pilgrim.
tagline: Shotgun-powered flight, procedural forests, and one pilgrim who is never full.
overview: Turkey Bois is a cooperative arena shooter where recoil is movement, the map changes between runs, and feeding the pilgrim means surviving a forest full of armed turkeys together.
studioNote: Turkey Bois is currently on hold. If development resumes, it would continue as a shared project with a friend rather than as a solo release.

highlights.title: Recoil is traversal
highlights.description: Every shotgun blast doubles as movement, turning combat into aerial routing and recovery.

highlights.title: Procedural runs
highlights.description: Changing forest layouts keep navigation, enemy pressure, and co-op decisions fresh.

highlights.title: Proximity voice
highlights.description: Spatial communication keeps a scattered team connected without flattening the sense of distance.

highlights.title: Connected systems design
highlights.description: The project brings networking, procedural generation, movement, and combat into one deliberately strange loop.
